steps.instruction: Bring 3 cups of water to a boil in a saucepan.
Slowly add 1 cup of millet flour, stirring all the time.
steps.spoken: Slowly add 1 cup of millet flour to the boiling water, stirring all the time so no lumps form.

steps.instruction: Turn the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add a pinch of salt and keep stirring.
Take the pan off the heat and let the porridge cool to room temperature.
Cover the porridge with a clean cloth and let it ferment overnight.
steps.spoken: Cover the porridge with a clean cloth and leave it to ferment overnight, for at least 8 hours.

steps.instruction: The next morning, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a separate pan.
Pour the porridge into the pan and heat it over medium heat, stirring.
steps.spoken: Pour the porridge into the pan and heat it over medium heat, stirring all the time, until it is as thick as you like. You can add more water for a thinner porridge.
